column1: # Submission ledger - the single source of truth for duplicate-submission checking.
# Keep ONE of these, somewhere above all your project folders. Putting a copy inside
# each project defeats the entire point: the risk is cross-project.
# manuscript_id  stable id for THE SAME manuscript. Do NOT change it when you retarget
#                to another venue - changing it is exactly how the guard stops working.
# project        folder name (relative to this file) or an absolute path
# venue          journal / conference, with the submission id once you have one
# status         drafting | submitted | under_review | revision | accepted | published
#                submitted/under_review/revision = UNDER REVIEW; only one per manuscript_id
# updated        YYYY-MM-DD you last confirmed the status (>120 days triggers a nudge)
# note           submission id, editor's message, why it was withdrawn or retargeted
# 'unknown' provides NO protection - resolve those before they matter.
